character: An old tengu woman, a crow-headed person, black feathers with a faint grey salt-tarnish, small rings along her beak. Beady black eyes, head tilted, beak closed. Her fingers held up, mid-count.
wardrobe: A weathered captain's coat, every button a different metal, talons in ship-leather boots, rings on every finger.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing very straight in a dark stone corridor, one hand raised, fingers counting.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer, eyes narrowed.

scene.framing: Walking a long narrow corridor of numbered locked iron doors in a tall dark vault-tower, one door open on a bare stone room holding a single ledger on a stand.
